先把方程整理成 ax²+bx+c=0，且 a≠0。移項後才讀取係數；負號屬於係數: First write the equation as ax²+bx+c=0, with a≠0. Read the coefficients after rearranging; each sign belongs to its coefficient.
把乘積等於零轉成各因子等於零。找出全部根，再按題目的較大、較小或情境條件選擇。: When a product is zero, set each factor equal to zero. Find all roots, then select the larger, smaller or contextually valid root.
使用 x=(-b±√(b²−4ac))/(2a)，保留負號及括號。代入原方程核對: Use x=(-b±√(b²−4ac))/(2a), keeping the signs and brackets. Substitute back to check. The order of the ± signs does not determine which root is larger.
D=b²−4ac。D>0 有兩個相異實根，D=0 有二重實根，D<0 沒有實根；: D=b²−4ac. D>0 gives two distinct real roots, D=0 a repeated real root, and D<0 no real roots. This does not determine whether the roots are integers.
